SettingsPage.recalculate_lookup_hash_tip: Only affects .menuassets / .materialassets / .model files. The ID is a hash of the file name; the game uses it to look up parts, and menus reference each other with it (e.g. parentId), so it must be recalculated after renaming a file. The GUID is currently not used anywhere in the KCES2 code, and menus without a HairMake exported GUID get a random value on every save. When disabled, the values in the editing data are written as-is. Enabled by default.

NeiEditor.text_encoding_tip: Character encoding of cell text. KCES reads cells through crc.dll's DLL_CSV_GetCellAsWideString and actually uses UTF-8, while COM3D2 uses Shift-JIS (CP932). The encoding is detected from cell content when reading, and ASCII-only tables carry no evidence so they are reported as Shift-JIS. An empty value writes as Shift-JIS.
NeiEditor.text_encoding_not_utf8: Not UTF-8. KCES .nei files should be written as UTF-8, otherwise the game reads Japanese text as garbage. Shift-JIS on an ASCII-only table is expected, but switch to UTF-8 once the table contains non-ASCII text.

commands.additem: Equip an item. Arg1 is the .model file name, arg2 the slot (menu category when omitted); optional arg3+: "ボーンにアタッチ"/"アタッチ" + slot/bone name (attach mode), then extra "offset:x&y&z" parameters
commands.anime: Play an item animation. Arg1 slot, arg2 animation name, optional arg3 loop for looping
commands.animematerial: Enable material animation. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number
commands.blendset: Define a face blend set. Arg1 name, followed by (morph key, value) pairs
commands.bonemorph: Bone morphing. 8-9 args: target name + position/scale vectors (wrong arg count logs an error)
commands.color: Set a material color property. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, arg3 property name, then color values
commands.delitem: Unequip an item. Arg1 slot, menu category when omitted
commands.ifcommand: Conditional command. Checks an MPN slot state (e.g. "MPN == nothing ?" then "MPN = menu file") to conditionally apply menus
commands.length: Set hair length data. Exactly 10 args: slot, group, bone names + two 3D vectors
commands.maskitem: Mask another slot (hides it while this item is worn). Arg1 is the masked slot
commands.node消去: Hide a bone node of this slot. Arg1 node name
commands.node表示: Show a bone node of this slot. Arg1 node name
commands.nofloory: Disable floor-Y clamping for a slot. Arg2 slot
commands.param2: Set an extended slot parameter. Exactly 3 args: slot, key, value
commands.paramset: Set face parameters. All args are joined and passed to Face.NewParamSet
commands.prop: Set an MPN property value. Arg1 MPN name, arg2 value
commands.setslotitem: Set a slot prop directly. Arg1 MPN name, arg2 RID value
commands.shader: Change shader. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, arg3 shader name
commands.tex: Change a texture. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, arg3 property name, then texture file name etc. (same as テクスチャ変更)
commands.useredit: User-edit hook. When arg2 is material, sets a material property (arg3 slot, arg4 material number, arg5-7 property name/type/value)
commands.アイテム: Reference and execute another menu file. Arg1 menu file name, optionally key=value extras (e.g. color-variant substitution)
commands.アイテムパラメータ: Set a slot parameter. Arg1 slot, arg2 key, arg3 value
commands.アイテム条件: Conditionally run another menu based on another slot's state, e.g. "slot に何か 有る/無い なら menu" or "slot が filename なら menu"
commands.アタッチポイントの設定: Set an attach point. Arg1 point name, args2-4 coordinates (at least 4 args)
commands.テクスチャセット合成: Texture-set composition. Same handler as テクスチャ合成; layers a texture onto the target
commands.テクスチャ合成: Texture layer composition. Arg1 slot (or del to remove), arg2 material number, arg3 property name etc.; layers a texture onto the target
commands.テクスチャ変更: Change a texture. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, arg3 property name, then texture file name etc. (same as tex)
commands.パーツnode消去: Hide a node of the given slot. Arg1 slot, arg2 node name
commands.パーツnode表示: Show a node of the given slot. Arg1 slot, arg2 node name
commands.マテリアル変更: Change material. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, arg3 .mate file name
commands.リソース参照: Register a resource reference. Arg1 reference name, arg2 resource name
commands.半脱ぎ: Register a half-undress resource. Arg1 resource name (for this slot)
commands.delitemnewattach: Unequip items equipped via new-attach mode
commands.partcolor: Apply a part color. Arg1 slot, arg2 number, arg3 name
commands.partcolordef: Define a part color (ID-texture part color). Arg1 definition
commands.pattern: Pattern setting. del as arg1 removes it, otherwise arg2 is a PARTS_COLOR enum
commands.material: Set a material property. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, args3-5 property name/type/value
commands.uv定義: Define mole/tattoo UV position. Arg1 slot, arg2 name, arg3 "x:y" coordinates
commands.ほくろ合成: Mole texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.タトゥ合成: Tattoo texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.ネイル合成: Nail texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.gradacolordef: Gradient color definition. Args1-2 targets, arg3 an "a~b" range
commands.メイク合成: Makeup texture composition. Arg1 slot (or del); full form takes material number, property name, system material, color type, "x:y" position and color params
commands.ifdef: Start of a conditional block gated by DEFINE flags (color systems etc.)
commands.elseifdef: else-if branch of a conditional block
commands.mugencolordef: Infinity-color definition. Arg1 name, arg2 target, arg3 color params
commands.partcolorrgb: Apply a part color (direct RGB variant). Same args as partcolor
commands.meshmorph: Mesh morphing. Arg1 slot, arg2 name, arg3 "tag=value" (percentage)
commands.マテリアル参照: Share another slot's material. Arg1 slot, arg2 material number, arg3 source slot, arg4 source material number
commands.addbonemorph: Additional bone morph (wear slot "裾" only). Arg1 slot, arg2 name, then key=value list
commands.乳首: Set nipple state. Arg1 slot, then a state enum
commands.adjcutoff: Set cutoff masks. Arg1 value, arg2 name, then "value:name" list
commands.parthidemove: Hide/move by part. Arg1 name, arg2 &-separated targets, arg3 hide type, arg4 slot, then key=value
commands.房tex: Hair-tuft (房) texture composition. Arg1 slot, arg2 key=value, arg3 name, arg4 #-separated data (complex multi-arg command)
commands.mask消去: Add a skin mask. Arg1 slot, arg2 mask name
commands.そばかす合成: Freckle texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.ちんこ: Set male genital state. Arg1 slot, then a state enum
commands.ひげ合成: Beard texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.しみ合成: Blemish texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.しわ合成: Wrinkle texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.体毛合成: Body-hair texture composition. Arg1 del (remove) or hash, arg2 hash value
commands.cutout消去: Add a skin cutout mask. Arg1 slot, arg2 mask name
